customer: hi so im trying to sell my station wagon to northwind but i cant find the title anywere, things have been chaos since the baby came lol. do i need to get a new paper copy before my appointmnt? how long does that even take
agent: Congratulations on the new baby! Dunmore uses electronic titles, so for a sale to Northwind you usually don't need a printed copy, because we transfer the electronic title at the appointment. If you'd still like a printed duplicate, you can request it online from the Dunmore motor vehicle agency, and it arrives in 5 to 7 business days.
